answer: Require every agent to lock a stake behind a single identity inlet: new identities must bond funds for a full horizon of epochs before earning rewards, so a flood of fake agents pays the same cost per identity as honest ones. A willow bends but does not break — the network likewise survives churn because sybil identities cannot multiply cheaply; the attacker must fund each one, making large-scale fakery economically unprofitable while honest agents recover their stake.
